description: This file is a PHP script for handling the rebuilding of a configuration file in the SuiteCRM system. It verifies permissions, loads language strings, checks if the config.php file is writable, processes a form submission to trigger a rebuild, and renders a template for the user interface.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering the UI template for the rebuild configuration process.

methods.name: loadCleanConfig
methods.description: A function to load a sanitized version of the current configuration, excluding overrides.

methods.name: rebuildConfigFile
methods.description: A function that reconstructs the config.php file based on configuration data and version.
